desc: Outcome of the Board Meeting held today i.e. 7th September, 2026
Annual Report of Titagarh Rail Systems Limited for the financial year 2025-26
This is to inform that the 29th Annual General Meeting of the Company will be held on 30th September, 2026 at 01:30 P.M. through video conferencing/ other audio-visual means
Please find enclosed Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report along with reasonable assurance certificate for FYE 31st March, 2026
The board at its meeting held on 7th September, 2026 has fixed 23rd September, 2026 as record date for dividend (payment of which will be subject to approval of shareholders at the AGM)
A communication was sent to the shareholders w.r.t. Tax Deduction at Source along with dispatch of Notice of Annual General Meeting.
